chapter_title_en: Foreshadowed Winds: The Grand Yin Scripture
chapter_seo_title: Han Li Unlocks the Grand Yin Scripture and Faces the Void Heaven Cauldron
chapter_meta_description: Han Li activates Xuan Gu’s rib bone, revealing the Grand Yin Scripture. He learns secret arts, fails to open the Void Heaven Cauldron, and pivots to refining his flying swords.
og_title: Han Li’s Rib Discovery: A Demonic Scripture Hidden in Bone
og_description: Behind the beast’s rib lies the Grand Yin Scripture. Han Li harvests usable techniques, shelves the unopenable Void Heaven Cauldron, and preps for the long sea campaign.
twitter_title: That’s No Ordinary Rib—It’s a Demon Scripture!
twitter_description: Han Li finds secret arts, fails to open a legendary cauldron, then calmly switches gears to sword forging. The Mortal Stream way.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary demonic cultivation manual focused on extreme yin/ghost-path power. In RMJI, it is the source of the Blood Essence Divine Light and contains several secret arts including the Celestial Corpse Fire.

A devastating demonic flame technique derived from the Grand Yin Scripture. Han Li discovers its weakness while reading the cultivation instructions, giving him a potential counter against Extreme Yin.

The number one sealed treasure of the Chaotic Star Sea, rumored to contain the Heaven-Mending Pill and other ancient treasures. It is impervious to all of Han Li’s current methods and requires a specific key or vastly higher cultivation to open.

An ultra-hard ore refined from demon beast cores and special minerals. It requires months of continuous mana infusion with the help of a formation to be melted into weapons, making it accessible only to cultivators with massive mana reserves or restoring items like Ten-Thousand-Year Spirit Milk.
A rare spirit insect that produces golden silk. Han Li has two of them, which have ingested five-colored round pills and are still awaiting a reaction.
A legendary-grade mana-restoring liquid that can sustain continuous spellcasting or refining for extended periods. Han Li’s stock is a key resource enabling his ambitious sword-remaking plan.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li disappointed by the Grand Yin Scripture?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is already committed to the Azure Origin Sword Art and cannot switch paths; the true value is in the usable secret arts in the second half.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Han Li open the Void Heaven Cauldron?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is designed to be opened only by someone with the correct key or at least Nascent Soul cultivation; his Core Formation attempts are far too weak to leave any mark.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li pivot to refining his swords instead of trying harder?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Mortal Stream philosophy values efficient resource allocation. He identifies a productive task that will directly improve his combat power for the upcoming sea campaign.
